description: Archeops was a balloon-borne bolometer experiment, using Planck high-frequency-instrument technology, to map cosmic microwave background temperature anisotropy over a large fraction of the sky.
facility_description: Archeops flew from a stratospheric balloon and scanned the millimetre sky in total power along large circles at constant elevation.
notes: The abstract quote is taken from the arXiv abstract page, including its backslash-tilde before 100muK. No requested user acknowledgement was found. The only reuse terms opened for the article are the arXiv non-exclusive licence, which does not grant further reuse and says to contact the author. That is not a grant to redistribute a separate numeric curve. No magnitude system was recorded.
